ItemId.description: The rule's 26-character id; omit it to match by tax code and first day, or create one.

TaxCode.description: The tax's code, the same for every dated version, such as US-CA-SIT or CA-CPP.

Jurisdiction.description: The jurisdiction, such as US, US-CA, CA or CA-QC.

CollectedBy.description: The jurisdiction whose registration covers the tax when it isn't the rule's own, such as CA for a province's tax the CRA collects.

ExceptJurisdictions.description: Jurisdictions whose people the rule doesn't apply to, such as CA-QC for the Canada Pension Plan.

ByPlaceOfWork.description: Match the jurisdiction by where the person works when that is known, never by where they live (Canada's province of employment).

IncomeKinds.description: The kinds of income the rule applies to; empty for employment income (or contractor payments for ContractorWithholding).

Category.description: The tax category whose income is taxed: IncomeTax, SocialInsurance, Unemployment or one a country pack adds.

Source.description: The kind of rule, which decides the fields its editor shows: FlatRate, ShareOfTax, TaxTable, FixedAmount, or one a country pack adds, such as UnitedStatesFormW4, CanadaFederal, CanadaProvincial or QuebecTP1015. Omitted, it comes from the method and the share.

Method.description: A Taxation calculation method (Percentage, FixedAmount, TaxTable, Progressive or Threshold) or a withholding method a country pack adds, such as UnitedStatesFormW4, CanadaFederal, CanadaProvincial or QuebecTP1015.

Rate.description: The rate as a percent, such as 6.2.

TaxTableId.description: The id of a Taxation tax table (rates in its rows are fractions).

WageBase.description: The most income taxed in a calendar year.

WageThreshold.description: The income of a calendar year above which the tax starts; only the part over it is taxed (such as CPP2 above the first ceiling).

YearlyExemption.description: An amount of a year's income never taxed, taken off each pay in proportion to the periods of a year, such as the CPP basic exemption.

YearlyMaximum.description: The most tax taken in a calendar year, such as a contribution's maximum.

ShareOfTaxCode.description: The code of another tax of the same pay this rule is a share of, such as the employer's share of a contribution.

ShareMultiplier.description: How many times that tax the rule takes, such as 1.4 for the employer's EI premium.

Tables.description: A withholding method's Taxation tax table ids, by the method's key (for UnitedStatesFormW4: Single, MarriedFilingJointly, HeadOfHousehold and each with .Step2).

Parameters.description: A withholding method's amounts, by the method's key (for UnitedStatesFormW4: AdjustmentMarriedFilingJointly and Adjustment).

Annualize.description: Work the tax out on a year's wages.

UsesElections.description: Apply the person's election: exempt, allowances, extra withholding.

AllowanceAmount.description: What one allowance lowers a year's wages by.

SupplementalRate.description: The flat rate, as a percent, of supplemental wages.

SupplementalExcessRate.description: The rate, as a percent, of a year's supplemental wages above SupplementalExcessThreshold, whatever the method.

SupplementalExcessThreshold.description: The supplemental wages of a calendar year above which SupplementalExcessRate applies.

EffectiveFrom.description: The first pay date the rule applies to.

EffectiveTo.description: The last pay date, or null.

Enabled.description: Whether the rule is in use.

Rules.description: The tax rules to create, or update by id or by tax code and first day.
